maddeler.t: From اَلـ (al-, “the”) + سُودَان (sūdān, “black people”, a plural of أَسْوَد (ʔaswad, “black, black person”)). Historically, the term was used to refer to Black Africa (Sub-Saharan region) in general.
s: اَلـ (al-, “the”) + سُودَان (sūdān, “black people”, a plural of أَسْوَد (ʔaswad, “black, black person”))
g: Sudan (a country in North Africa and East Africa)
